summary: Tested redesigned check-in form with inline family members. All features working correctly: standalone Family Members section removed, inline family member management per room, Self radio behavior (only one room), Dependent Card checkbox with conditional Dependent ID field, Def Civ rate calculation, and Bill Summary with per-room charges.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Redesigned check-in form fully tested. Key changes verified: 1) Standalone Family Members section removed, 2) Each room has 'Add Family Member' button for inline family member management, 3) Self checkbox has radio behavior (only one room at a time), 4) Family member form includes Relation, Name, Age, Sex, Mobile, 5) 'Dependent Card Available?' checkbox controls visibility of 'Dependent ID Ser No' field, 6) Room charge category updates to 'Def Civ' when any family member lacks dependent card, 7) Bill Summary shows per-room charges with correct rates. Backend correctly stores room_guest_mapping with has_self and family_members structure.
